_comment: UNIRA V6.4 money circuit, France region pilot. Rules from v63/DESIGN_CLARIFICATIONS_2026-11-03.md (numbers = rule ids). Every parameter carries an evidence class.

employment_rate_20_64.note: universal work; closes the year-1 30 h gap in v63/ledger (universal_88)

multiplier_by_isco.note: Occupation (ISCO-08 major group) is used as a proxy for knowledge/study and job complexity; experience spread within a group is not modelled. Values are illustrative and must be set democratically. Owners/managers are capped at 5x.

public_service_employment_share.note: persons in NACE O+P+Q / all employed, 2023 national accounts (v62)

unable_to_work_share_20_64.note: MISSING: national disability statistics needed (5,000 U guarantee pool)

child_allowance.note: spec formula; 'GE3' households counted as 3 children (lower bound)

retiree_needs.note: Needs-based, case by case. Proposal: a single retiree's living basket (food, daily life, 1 holiday/yr) = what a base worker spends after saving 50% (2,500 U/month); couple = 1.5x (OECD modified scale); renters receive housing cost on top.
retiree_needs.rent_note: MODEL_DERIVED: average home 300,000 U repaid interest-free over 50 years = 500 U/month (rules 11 and 16)

residential_share_of_construction_gfcf.note: share of construction investment hours that builds or renovates dwellings; to be replaced by national accounts dwelling GFCF

experience_creep_per_year.note: average multiplier drift if no rule keeps the distribution matched to output

lifecycle._comment: Rules 11-18. Behavioural parameters are SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION unless stated: no UNIRA economy has been observed.

saving_range.evidence_class: NORMATIVE_TARGET (rule 17: personal choice, max 50%); uniform spread is SYNTHETIC

initial_owner_share.evidence_class: VERIFIED_OFFICIAL share of population in owner households (Eurostat ilc_lvho02, FR 2023); age gradient SYNTHETIC

new_homes_per_adult_year.evidence_class: MODEL_DERIVED from V6.4 base circuit (~1.1 m homes/yr / ~52.8 m adults 20+) with 50% residential share SYNTHETIC

credit_repay_share.evidence_class: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: zero-interest credit repaid from salary, at most 30% of salary

cap_coef_initial.evidence_class: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: initial cap = 10 years of base salary (600,000 U)

deposit_target_months.evidence_class: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: total deposits kept at about 12 months of consumption (to be linked to reserve stocks)

gompertz.evidence_class: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION (modal age at death ~81); replace with INSEE/Eurostat life table

cap_low_credit._note: cap floor 1 year of base salary (60,000 U); homes financed by zero-interest credit

cap_low_credit_need_first._note: as above + second homes only when no one in the region waits for a first home
